additional_info.subject: RE: 0406824 - ID0406824-DC/Si-D-PL-[MP / R2 170001500] Charger takes around 7kW in standby. CRM:02023000511
additional_info.body:
Hi,
The station was measured in several states during measurements:
- open,
- closed,
- closed with off: FC18, FC20, FC21, FC22,
- closed with the emergency button pressed,
The measurement was made on the charger's power supply inside before 3VA. Rogowski coils were salivated on the power cables and voltage probes on the 3VA buses.
Open state::
- the station has a consumption of 300-400 watts,
Closed state:
- the station has a consumption of 7558 W,
Closed station with circuits turned off:
- consumption not much less 7500 W,
Station closed with emergency button pressed:
- consumption like an open station - 300-400W,
The stations were checked on the power supply of the power modules:
- each phase of the modules consume between 0.9 - 1.1 A. I attached is a video.
Best regards
Smart Infrastructures Team
eMobility - Poland
